name: example-agency-listings
title: listings page kind
description: A static directory or listings page kind: search, browse categories, filters, a results grid, a comparison table, a featured listing, optional reviews and an inquiry step. Fits real estate, rentals, holiday stays, marketplaces and local directories. Composed from twelve vendored HyperUI blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript.

query.en: Use the listings family for a static directory or listings mock (real estate, rentals, holiday stays, a marketplace or a local directory): search, categories, filters, results, a comparison, a featured listing, optional reviews and an inquiry step. Ask for the business, what it lists and where, generate a schemaVersion 2 listings typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every business fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder.
